resources.string: Your home screen. See today\'s sales at a glance and jump to common tasks quickly.

string-array.name: help_dashboard_s1
string-array.item: Total amount and bill count for today.
Top items chart shows your best sellers by quantity.

string-array.name: help_dashboard_s2
string-array.item: New Bill — create a sale invoice.
Customers — manage buyer details.
Items — manage products and prices.
Bills History — view, filter, and export past bills.
Settings — shop name, invoice layout, backup, and more.

resources.string: Create a new sales invoice. Add a customer, line items, and save. Works fully offline.

string-array.name: help_new_bill_s1
string-array.item: Buyer name — pick an existing customer or type a new name.
Address & phone — optional; auto-filled when you select a customer.
Add new customer — save buyer details to your customer list.

string-array.name: help_new_bill_s2
string-array.item: Add item — search and select from your item master.
Scan barcode — use the camera to find an item quickly.
Each line shows MRP, discount %, quantity, and line total.
Total discount and grand total update automatically.

string-array.name: help_new_bill_s3
string-array.item: Save bill — stores the invoice and assigns a bill number.
Menu (⋮) — hold bill for later, open held bills, or leave without saving.
Back — prompts to hold or discard if you have unsaved changes.

resources.string: Read-only view of a saved bill from Bills History. Download PDF or print from the menu.

string-array.name: help_bill_view_s1
string-array.item: All fields are read-only — customer, items, and totals.
Header and signature images come from your invoice settings.

string-array.name: help_bill_view_s2
string-array.item: Download PDF — save or share the invoice file.
Print — open the PDF with a print app.

resources.string: Bills you paused while creating a new sale. Resume to continue editing or delete if no longer needed.

string-array.name: help_held_bills_s1
string-array.item: Tap Resume to restore a held bill on the New Bill screen.
Delete removes the held draft permanently.
Hold a bill from New Bill menu when you need to serve another customer first.

resources.string: Preview the invoice PDF right after saving a new bill.

string-array.name: help_bill_preview_s1
string-array.item: View the rendered invoice using your default template.
Share or open the PDF from the on-screen actions.

resources.string: Maintain your buyer list. Saved customers can be picked quickly when creating bills.

string-array.name: help_customers_s1
string-array.item: Tap a customer to edit name, address, and phone.
Delete removes the customer (existing bills keep the name used at sale time).

string-array.name: help_customers_s2
string-array.item: + button — open the add customer form.
Name is required; address and phone are optional.
Save stores the customer for future bills.

resources.string: Your product master. Items added here appear when billing and can be scanned by barcode.

string-array.name: help_items_s1
string-array.item: Each card shows name, MRP, discount, and selling price.
Tap to edit; delete removes the item from the master.

string-array.name: help_items_s2
string-array.item: + button — add a new product.
Name and MRP are required. Barcode is optional for scanning.
Discount % applies when the item is added to a bill (unless selling price is set).
Selling price overrides discount calculation when provided.

resources.string: Browse all saved invoices. Filter, sort, open, duplicate, delete, or export reports.

string-array.name: help_bills_history_s1
string-array.item: Menu (⋮) — toggle search, date range, and counter filters.
Sort — by date (oldest first) or invoice number (ascending).
Clear filters resets active filter values.

string-array.name: help_bills_history_s2
string-array.item: Tap a bill to view it read-only.
Duplicate creates a new editable copy.
Delete removes the bill permanently.
Download PDF/Excel report exports filtered sales data.
Upload Excel backup imports sales from a backup file.

resources.string: Restore sales data from an exported .xlsx backup file. Useful when moving to a new device.

string-array.name: help_excel_upload_s1
string-array.item: Use a file exported from Vikr Saathi or matching the required column format.
Duplicate bill numbers are skipped automatically.
Review the preview before confirming import.

resources.string: Configure your shop, invoices, backups, and data management.

string-array.name: help_settings_s1
string-array.item: General — shop name, currency, default discount.
Invoice Configuration — images, counter, and layout templates.
Backup & Restore — export and import your full data.
Reset — clear data or restore from a JSON backup.

resources.string: Basic shop preferences used across bills and reports.

string-array.name: help_general_settings_s1
string-array.item: Shop name — shown on dashboard toolbar and invoices.
Currency symbol — used for all amounts (e.g. ₹).
Default discount % — pre-filled when adding items to a bill.
Changes save automatically when you leave a field.

resources.string: Hub for invoice images, bill numbering, and template layouts.

string-array.name: help_invoice_config_s1
string-array.item: Image Configuration — header and signature images on every PDF.
Invoice Counter — prefix, suffix, and next bill number.
Invoice Layout — open templates and the visual Invoice Builder.
In the builder, use ? on the page toolbar for tools and ? inside properties for each field.

resources.string: Set images that appear on every invoice — typically your shop header and authorised signature.

string-array.name: help_invoice_image_s1
string-array.item: Header image — banner or logo at the top of the invoice.
Signature image — shown near the bottom of the invoice.
Pick from gallery; changes apply to new PDFs immediately.

resources.string: Control how bill numbers are generated for each new sale.

string-array.name: help_invoice_counter_s1
string-array.item: Prefix / suffix — text before and after the number (e.g. INV-001-A).
Next number — the counter used for the next new bill.
Minimum digits — pads the number (e.g. 3 → 001, 002).

resources.string: List of invoice layouts. One template is used as the default for new bill PDFs.

string-array.name: help_invoice_templates_s1
string-array.item: Tap a template to open the Invoice Builder and edit its layout.
Set default — marks which template new bills use.
New template — create another layout from the built-in starting design.
Import JSON — load a shared template file from storage.
For field-by-field help while editing, use ? inside Element Properties or Table Columns.

resources.string: Visual editor for your invoice PDF. Drag elements on the canvas, then save the template.

string-array.name: help_invoice_builder_s1
string-array.item: Tap an element to select it; drag to move or resize handles.
+ (FAB) — add text, image, or table elements.
Edit element — opens properties for the selection.
Table columns — edit the items table when a table is selected.
Preview PDF — sample output with demo bill data.
Save — stores the template and records a version snapshot.
Menu (⋮) — grid, guides, import/export JSON, version history.

string-array.name: help_invoice_builder_s2
string-array.item: Undo / Redo — step through recent layout changes.
Multi-select — tap several elements; bulk-edit shared properties.
Delete — remove selected element(s).
Group / Ungroup — move multiple elements together.
Lock / Unlock — block or allow canvas moves for the selection.
Duplicate — copy the selected element.
Bring forward / Send backward — change stacking order one step.
Bring to front / Send to back — move to the top or bottom layer.
Detailed property help — tap ? in the Element Properties or Table Columns panel.

resources.string: Export all app data to a file or restore from a previous backup.

string-array.name: help_backup_s1
string-array.item: Export backup — saves customers, items, bills, settings, and templates.
Import backup — restores from a .json backup file on this device.
Files are saved under Documents → Vikr Saathi.

resources.string: Clear app data or restore from a full JSON backup. Use with caution.

string-array.name: help_reset_s1
string-array.item: Reset all data — deletes bills, customers, items, and settings.
Restore from backup — replaces current data with a backup file.
Always export a backup before resetting.
